$comment: Suppressions for scripts/check-site-leaks.mjs. Every entry is a decision to
publish something, recorded with a reason.
This file is the override for the leak check. Editing it requires a pull
request to main, which is protected with no bypass actors, so the choice to
publish is visible and attributable rather than a flag set in passing.
An entry without a `reason` suppresses nothing and fails the check outright.
A silent allowlist is how this class of problem started.

allow.reason: Explains that everything in site/ is public. Served at /README.md, which is harmless and arguably useful. Contains no infrastructure detail — reviewed 2026-08-02.
